This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 09.01.2026 (the "Effective
Date") by and between Müller Industrietechnik GmbH, with its registered office at Berliner Allee 19,
Köln ("Party A"), and Bayerische Werkzeuge GmbH & Co. KG, with its registered office at Hauptstraße
42, Köln ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 12 months from the Effective Date unless
terminated earlier in accordance with Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall
use it solely for the purposes of this Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York.

Signatures
 Party A  Müller Industrietechnik GmbH / Jürgen Hoffmann
 Party B  Bayerische Werkzeuge GmbH & Co. KG / Anna Weber
